findings.title: Uninformative comment in catch block
findings.body: According to custom instructions in 'Meaningful Comments for Complex Logic': A comment that restates the code, or no longer matches the changed code next to it, is removed or updated.: The comment '// ignored' does not explain why the error is being ignored. Update the comment to: '// Ignore error if devtools extension is not installed'
findings.suggestion: // Ignore error if devtools extension is not installed

summary.problem: The catch block contains an uninformative comment that only states what the code does, not why.
summary.done_well: The refactor simplifies the devtools middleware by replacing multiple overloads with a single implementation using a helper function and mutator types, improving maintainability.
